decisions.reason: As a large German machinery firm, the company has already publicly committed this core coolant-management product for two years and is likely to keep it because the investment and strategic fit with its established offer make withdrawal hard to justify.

This centrifuge sits squarely in the firm's established coolant-cleaning business and sustainability narrative, so prior investment, visible market commitment and the absence of clear failure signals favor continuation.

Although somewhat closer to rather than fully inside the established offer, the scraper belt chip conveyor still fits the firm's automation and material-flow portfolio, so escalation of commitment and ongoing listing make keeping it more likely than dropping it.

The hinged belt chip conveyor complements the firm's existing conveying solutions, and after keeping it on the market through 2024 management would likely continue rather than admit a misstep unless results had clearly deteriorated.
